title: Model catalog: capability endpoints - compatibility flags, pricing/limits, and streaming/function-calling stability updates
author: Sofia Nguyen
description: Add capability-focused model catalog endpoints and extend existing model listing with compatibility flags, pricing/limits metadata, and streaming/function-calling stability metadata. Motivation: customers and the gateway need richer metadata for automatic routing and UI filters (e.g., show only models that support streaming+function-calling with OpenAI-compat), and billing needs explicit per-model limits/price fields. This PR introduces: 1) /v1/models?capabilities=<comma-separated> and /v1/models/:id/capabilities endpoints exposing structured capability flags (streaming, function_calling, structured_output, openai_compatibility) as booleans and a simple "stability" enum for streaming/function-calling (stable|beta|experimental). 2) Pricing & limits fields on model catalog entries: price_per_token_read, price_per_token_write, max_context_tokens, max_output_tokens, rate_limits (per-minute). 3) Compatibility tags to help the OpenAI compatibility layer route to fallback variants and to advertise when a model supports OpenAI-style function calling semantics. 4) Streaming stability improvements in the API gateway to more gracefully fallback to chunked polling when SSE/WebSocket disconnects occur; added instrumentation to detect live fallback rate. 5) Tests, docs and a short migration guide for customers. Implementation notes: catalog service schema extended (migration included), API DTOs versioned to keep backward compatibility with existing clients, gateway has feature flag to opt-in to new streaming fallback behavior. Checklist: [x] schema migration [x] new endpoints + DTOs [x] gateway streaming fallback implementation behind ff [x] unit + integration tests [x] docs + migration guide [x] add linear/jira links. Backwards compatibility: existing /v1/models responses retain existing fields; new fields are additive. Consumers that care about new fields should request API version header 'Redwood-API-Version: 2026-02'. Rollout plan: migrate catalog entries, enable ff in canary for low-traffic customers, monitor streaming_fallback_rate and function_calling_errors metric. See linked linear tickets for perf follow-ups.
